metadata.title: Modding docs — Nebula
metadata.description: Learn to make mods for Nebula: LumaScript, LumaKit, services, content and the LumaLink tools, from your first mod to the full reference.

docs.searchEmpty: No pages match. Try a function, module or error code.
docs.previewText: These docs describe the modding toolkit coming with Nebula v2. Names and details may still change before release.

hub.title: Nebula modding docs
hub.intro: Write mods in LumaScript, build them with LumaLink and share a single .luma file. Start with the essentials, then go as deep as you like.
hub.playerTip: Only want to install mods made by others?
hub.startHeading: From nothing to a working mod.
hub.startIntro: Read these in order. Together they take you from what a mod is to building, running and debugging your own.
hub.tutorialsHeading: Tutorials, from a tweak to a galaxy.
hub.tutorialsIntro: Each tutorial is a complete mod, explained one file at a time.
hub.referenceIntro: The language, the libraries, the services, content formats, the command line and every error code.
